text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Describing what a shipment record contains says nothing about whether the customs module ships at launch; both hold."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus moving the launch date is a past event and is untouched by what is in scope for that launch."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The launch being on October 15th and the customs module being in scope for it are compatible facts about different things."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy working on shipment tracking does not conflict with the customs module being in scope; both can be true at once."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The file format of customs docs is independent of whether the customs module is in scope for launch."}]}
